resources.string: Lets HeyBuddy draw its pointer and notes on top of other apps, notice when you tap the spot it highlighted during a guided walkthrough, type text into the field you are using (always after you approve), take a screenshot when you call HeyBuddy, and start HeyBuddy from the accessibility button. HeyBuddy never reads your screen unless you call it, never acts without showing you, and keeps nothing it sees.
One tap to talk to HeyBuddy
